description: This file contains utility functions for tensor operations related to searchsorted, including tensor trimming, dimension checks, scalar tensor creation, and pre-checks for searchsorted operations within the ATen native library of PyTorch.

methods.name: searchsorted_maybe_trim_input_tensors
methods.description: Trims input tensors to be contiguous and of a common type if necessary, optimizing for searchsorted operations.

methods.name: searchsorted_dims_matched_before_last_dim
methods.description: Checks if the dimensions of boundary and input tensors match up to the second last dimension.

methods.name: searchsorted_scalar_tensor
methods.description: Converts a scalar to a tensor with the specified device, applying type promotion rules.

methods.name: searchsorted_pre_check
methods.description: Performs validation checks before executing searchsorted, including device, shape, dtype, and parameter constraints.
